description: How many of ONE product are on hand, broken down by variant and by outlet. Answers 'how many of these do I have', 'how many are left at the King Street shop', 'where is this product in stock'. Takes the product id from get_products — get_products itself returns prices, never quantities. Pass outletId (from get_outlets) to narrow it to a single shop. CRITICAL — "tracked: false" means the merchant switched stock counting OFF for that variant at that outlet, so there is NO count at all. It is NOT "0 in stock". Never say "you have 0" or "it is out of stock" about an untracked line; say stock is not being tracked there. Only lines with tracked: true carry a real quantity. Outlets where the product is hidden do not appear at all. For 'what is running out' across the whole catalogue use find_low_stock instead — do not page through products with this tool.

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets. Omit for every outlet

productId.description: Product id from get_products — not a name
